title: Goodnight, Big Moon Trucks | Calm Bedtime Story
description: Way up on the Moon, the big friendly trucks are getting sleepy. One by one, Digger Dot, Dumper Dan, Crane Belle and Mixer Max finish their gentle work and settle down to sleep under the glowing blue Earth. A slow, calm bedtime story for little ones who love trucks and the stars. New Moon Trucks stories every week.
narration:
High up on the Moon, where the dust is soft and grey and the sky is full of stars, the big friendly trucks were getting sleepy.

Night had come to the Moon. And far, far away, the great big Earth glowed in the dark sky — blue and green and shining — like the world's biggest, gentlest nightlight.

It was time for the Moon Trucks to go to sleep.

First was Digger Dot, the careful little excavator. She had one last job to do. Slowly, gently, she smoothed a soft patch of moon dust, flat and tidy and round. There. All done.

"Goodnight, Digger Dot," whispered the Moon.

Digger Dot lowered her arm down, down, down, until it rested on the soft grey ground. Her engine went rrrmmm… rrmmm… shhhhh. And then she was quiet.

Next was Dumper Dan, the big slow dump truck. He had one last load to tip. Up tilted his great big tray — slowly, slowly — and out tumbled a pile of soft glowing moon-pebbles, in a gentle little heap. Plip, plip, plip.

"Goodnight, Dumper Dan," whispered the Moon.

Dumper Dan lowered his tray back down with a soft, sleepy sigh. His engine went rrrmmm… rrmmm… shhhhh. And then he was quiet too.

Up tall stood Crane Belle, the gentle crane, with her long, long arm reaching high among the stars. She had one last thing to lift. Carefully, ever so carefully, she lifted the little flag down for the night and folded it soft and small.

"Goodnight, Crane Belle," whispered the Moon.

Crane Belle lowered her long arm down from the stars, slow and smooth. Her engine went rrrmmm… rrmmm… shhhhh. And then she rested.

Last of all was Mixer Max, the round, hummy cement mixer. All day his big drum had turned, round and round and round. Now it turned slower… and slower… and slower. Round… round… still.

"Goodnight, Mixer Max," whispered the Moon.

Mixer Max gave one last little hum, and his engine went rrrmmm… rrmmm… shhhhh. And then the Moon was peaceful and quiet.

All together now, the big friendly trucks rested side by side in their cosy crater, soft and snug in the moon dust. Digger Dot. Dumper Dan. Crane Belle. And Mixer Max.

The stars twinkled softly all around them. The big blue Earth glowed warm and gentle in the sky, watching over the sleepy Moon.

The trucks breathed slow and quiet. In, and out. In, and out.

Goodnight, Digger Dot. Goodnight, Dumper Dan. Goodnight, Crane Belle. Goodnight, Mixer Max.

Goodnight, big friendly Moon Trucks. Sleep now. Everything is calm. Everything is still.
